# Lentil / Polynomial Optics

Vendored generated lens polynomials from:

- https://github.com/zpelgrims/lentil (MIT)
- https://github.com/zpelgrims/pota (MIT)
- Polynomial Optics: Hanika, Droske, et al. — https://jo.dreggn.org/home/2016_optics.pdf

Only the auto-generated `*/code/*.h` polynomial evaluations and include switches
are included here. Arnold plugin glue is not shipped.
